Name: CS_SHADER_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Shader feature settings for each level of the Shader Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Subsurface Scattering Enabled
Fields.Description: Enables subsurface scattering (light passing through skin and similar materials). Retail: off on Off and Low.

Fields.Name: Tessellation Enabled
Fields.Description: Enables tessellation. Retail: on for High and Maximum.

Fields.Name: High-Precision Normals
Fields.Description: Stores surface normals in the G-buffer at higher precision. Retail: on for Maximum only.
